title: A Swift app opens a library and queries it
description:
As a Swift app developer, I want to open a library folder and query it with the same operations as the web client.

```gherkin
Feature: The Swift SDK
  Scenario: List clips of a collection
    Given a library migrated from the repository
    When a Swift client opens it and lists clips by collection "marine-band"
    Then it receives the Marine Band clips with their bpm and key
```
